title: Password Reset Policy
text: Customers can reset their account password from the login page by selecting 'Forgot password'. A reset link is emailed and expires after 30 minutes. No identity document is required for a self-service password reset.

title: Account Deactivation Policy
text: Customers may deactivate their account from account settings. Deactivation is reversible within 30 days by logging back in. After 30 days the account and associated data are permanently deleted.

title: Internal Expense Reimbursement Guide
text: Employees may submit expense reimbursements up to $500 without manager approval. Expenses above $500 require written manager sign-off before submission. Travel expenses must include itemized receipts.

title: Internal Remote Work Guidelines
text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week without special approval. Fully remote arrangements require HR and manager approval and are reviewed annually.

title: Homeowners Policy POL-1001 Coverage Summary
text: Policy POL-1001 covers structural fire damage and windstorm damage up to $250,000. It explicitly excludes flood damage and damage caused by gradual water seepage. Claims for flood damage require a separate flood insurance rider, which this policy does not include.

title: Homeowners Policy POL-1002 Coverage Summary
text: Policy POL-1002 covers theft and fire damage up to $150,000. Water damage from burst pipes is covered if the pipe failure was sudden and accidental. Flood damage from external sources is excluded.

title: Auto Policy POL-2001 Coverage Summary
text: Policy POL-2001 provides liability and collision coverage for the named driver. It does not cover damage occurring while the vehicle is used for commercial ridesharing purposes.
